sentences.text:
The petitioner seeks the grant of anticipatory bail under Section 482 BNSS, 2023 (Section 438 Cr.P.C.) in case bearing FIR No.0012 dated 29.06.2022 under Sections 193, 196, 199, 200, 406, 409,
418, 420, 467, 468, 471, 474, 477-A and 120-B IPC and Sections 13(1)(C) & (d) P.C. Act, registered at Police Station State Vigilance Bureau, Hisar.

entities.text: Police Station State Vigilance Bureau, Hisar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that pursuant to the interim order dated 23.09.2025 passed by this Court, the petitioner has joined the investigation.

The learned State counsel on instructions from Inspector Satyawan submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation in terms of the order dated 23.09.2025 and is not required for custodial interrogation.
In view of the above, the interim order dated 23.09.2025 is made absolute.
However, the petitioner shall keep on joining the investigation as and when required to do so and he shall abide by the conditions as envisaged under Section 482(2) BNSS.
